title: Monitor-Validity Failures: LLM Safety Evidence Paths at Evolving Framework Boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2610.23362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern LLM applications rely on runtime monitors that inspect tool calls, traces, streams, detector outputs, and verifier inputs. This creates an interface-reliability problem: a framework path may remain operational while policy-relevant evidence never reaches its decision point. In one representative case, a regex detector returned a positive match, but the framework stranded the result before the block decision. This differs from jailbreaks and detector errors because the evidence is already recognized yet disconnected from enforcement. We study this repair-boundary signature with canary contracts: parent/fixed confirmation units that place a known payload only on the changed evidence surface and record monitor visibility together with the downstream decision for action-boundary cases. translated_title: 监控有效性失效：演化框架边界处的LLM安全证据路径
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型应用依赖运行时监控器来检查工具调用、执行轨迹、数据流、检测器输出和验证器输入。这带来了一个接口可靠性问题：框架路径可能仍在正常运行，但与策略相关的证据却从未到达其决策点。在一个代表性案例中，正则表达式检测器返回了阳性匹配结果，但框架在阻断决策之前将该结果搁置了。这不同于越狱攻击和检测器误判，因为证据已经被识别，却与执行机制断开了连接。我们使用“金丝雀契约”来研究这种修复边界特征：这是一种父级/固定确认单元，它仅在发生变更的证据表面上放置已知载荷，并记录监控器的可见性以及动作边界情况下的下游决策。将该协议应用于公开的框架修复中，我们在11个大语言模型或智能体安全项目组中确认了18个证据路径失效，并覆盖四个实现……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“金丝雀契约”测试协议，用于发现LLM安全框架中的一种新型故障——“监控有效性失效”，即风险证据已被检测器识别却在框架内部丢失、未能送达阻断决策点——并在11个LLM/智能体安全项目组中确认了18个此类证据路径失效案例。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "canary contracts," a testing protocol for detecting monitor-validity failures in LLM safety frameworks—where risk evidence is already recognized by detectors but stranded before reaching enforcement decisions—and confirms 18 such evidence-path failures across 11 LLM/agent safety project groups.
